changelog.message: op created for native Node N-API-backed Apple Vision 3D human pose tracker
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Tracks 3D human body pose joints, height, and coordinates in real-time from an input WebGL texture using macOS Apple Vision neural frameworks directly in memory.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Starts or stops the native HumanPose3d tracking engine.

ports.name: Render
ports.text: Trigger render loop to process the incoming texture.

ports.name: Texture
ports.text: WebGL Texture containing the human subject to track.

ports.name: Poses Array
ports.text: An array of detected 3D poses containing tracked skeletal joint names, 3D coordinates (x/y/z in meters relative to the camera), estimated body height, and confidence levels.

ports.name: Detected Poses
ports.text: Total number of human bodies currently tracked in the active frame.

ports.name: On Poses Detected
ports.text: Trigger fired every time a new set of 3D pose landmarks is received.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native 3D pose tracking engine is active.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the tracking engine.
